text.description_html:
AHI AP-SIG441-630, Contemporary Square Stainless Steel Appliance Pull

This very contemporary designed appliance door pull is made of solid stainless steel by AHI Hardware, a leader in stainless door hardware. Warm Satin Stainless Steel finish for a truly eye catching contemporary design. They requiring little maintenance, designed to enhance any setting where a modern, sophisticated look is desired.

Also available: Matching Contemporary Square Stainless Door Lever

Specifications for the AHI AP-SIG441 Contemporary Appliance Pull:

  • Material: Solid Stainless Steel
  • Finish: Satin Stainless Steel
  • Total Height: 420 mm (16.53")
  • Mounting Centers: 350 mm (13.78") C/C
  • Projection: 60 mm (2.36")
  • Diameter: 24 mm (1.00") Square
  • Pull Mounting: Standard 3/4" Thick Appliance Panel

Sold individually.
